title: Postcode Configuration Page: display the stored provider selection on open
summary: The Postcode Configuration Page now displays the currently stored provider selection when opened, preventing the configured value from being cleared when closing the page with OK.
key_points: Page 9143 loads the stored service key into the display variable on open
Previously configured provider selection is preserved when the user closes the page with OK
Test added to verify the page shows the configured provider and preserves it
Legacy pages 10501 and 10503 left unchanged as they are obsolete
Resolves issue where configured provider appeared empty on page open
